svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Bracket: 40 mm of 40 x 40 x 4 mm angle. Upright leg: two 6.5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes 24 mm apart, 20 mm down. Flat leg: two 5.5 mm holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Target plate: 120 x 120 mm of 3 mm aluminium, painted matt white;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: scribe two rings, 10 and 25 mm radius, at its centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pin: 8 mm steel rod 183 mm long, threaded M8 for 15 mm at one end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through a centre hole with a nut each side, square to the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the bracket's upright leg on the outside of the rim band at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the lowest point of the dish, the plate on the flat leg flush

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the rim edge; the pin is parallel to the dish axis.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: an engineer's square on the plate touches the pin.
